_comment: Shared policy test vectors. Go (internal/policy/vectors_test.go) and the Worker (worker/test/policy-wasm.test.ts) both run every vector, so the CLI preview and the server decision cannot drift. Edit by hand; the example policy must stay identical to examples/policy.yaml.

policies.example:
# Demo policy for Wayglass. Copy to .wayglass/policy.yaml (wayglass init does
# this for you). Rules are checked top to bottom; the first enforcing rule that
# matches decides.
#
# Trying a new rule: add `mode: shadow` (the default is `mode: enforce`). A
# shadow rule never decides; every decision records the shadow rules that
# matched and whether the first of them would have changed the action. Run
# `wayglass policy test` to replay recent commits through this file, then drop
# `mode: shadow` once the rule does what you expect. Example:
#   - { when: { area: web, data_class: pii }, action: quarantine, reason: "Trial: all PII review.", mode: shadow }
version: 1
classify:
  area:
    docs: ["docs/**", "**/*.md"]
    web: ["web/**"]
    auth: ["**/auth/**", "**/login*"]
    infra: ["worker/wrangler.jsonc", ".github/**"]
  data_class:
    # Secrets: any added line that looks like a credential, or any file that
    # usually holds one. Regexes are RE2 (no lookaround), matched one added
    # line at a time; evidence records the pattern and the line number, never
    # the matched text. Cloudflare API tokens have no fixed prefix, so they
    # are not listed; name the variable (api_key) and the first pattern finds it.
    secrets:
      content:
        - "(?i)api[_-]?key"
        - "art_v[0-9]+_([a-z]+_)?[0-9a-f]{40}"                            # Artifacts repo token
        - "-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"                            # PEM private key (RSA, EC, OPENSSH, ...)
        - "\\b(A3T[A-Z0-9]|AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\\b"                     # AWS access key id
        - "\\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,}"                                 # GitHub token
        - "\\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}"                               # GitHub fine-grained token
        - "\\bsk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"                                  # Anthropic API key
        - "\\bsk-(proj-|svcacct-|admin-)?[A-Za-z0-9_]{8}[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}" # OpenAI API key (sk-ant- has a dash in the first eight, so it is the line above)
        - "\\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}"                               # Slack token
        - "\\b[sr]k_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"                                # Stripe live key
        - "\\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}"                                      # Google API key
      # Files that hold keys, whatever their lines say (a binary file has no
      # lines to scan). Globs cannot exclude a name, so the env files are
      # listed one by one: .env.example and .env.sample are templates and stay
      # out; add the names your project uses.
      paths:
        - "**/*.pem"
        - "**/*.p12"
        - "**/*.pfx"
        - "**/*.key"
        - "**/id_rsa"
        - "**/id_ed25519"
        - "**/.env"
        - "**/.env.{local,development,dev,production,prod,staging,stage,test,ci}"
    pii: { content: ["(?i)\\bssn\\b", "(?i)date_of_birth"] }
  risk:
    high: { lines_changed_over: 400, binary_bytes_over: 250000 }
# Binary files cannot be content-scanned. Any binary file outside this list
# goes to a person (builtin:unscanned-binary); this list is the default when
# the key is absent, and `allow: []` sends every binary file to a person.
binary:
  allow: ["**/*.png", "**/*.jpg", "**/*.jpeg", "**/*.gif", "**/*.webp", "**/*.ico", "**/*.woff", "**/*.woff2"]
rules:
  - { when: { data_class: secrets }, action: block, reason: "Secrets never land." }
  - { when: { area: infra }, action: multi_approve, approvers: 2, reason: "Infra changes affect everyone." }
  - { when: { area: auth }, action: human_approve, reason: "Auth is a security boundary." }
  - { when: { jurisdiction: eu, data_class: pii }, action: quarantine, reason: "EU personal data needs DPO review." }  # fires on the eu demo namespace
  - { when: { only_area: docs, risk: low }, action: auto_merge, reason: "Routine docs change; every file is docs." }
  - { when: { risk: low }, action: agent_review, reason: "Low risk; second agent checks intent vs diff." }
default: { action: human_approve, reason: "No rule matched; a person decides." }
policies.open:
version: 1
classify:
  area:
    config: [".wayglass/**"]
    docs: ["docs/**"]
rules:
  - { name: anything-goes, when: { risk: low }, action: auto_merge, reason: "Demo: everything auto-merges." }
default: { action: auto_merge, reason: "Demo: everything auto-merges." }
policies.family:
version: 1
classify:
  area:
    tests: ["**/*_test.go"]
rules:
  - { name: tests-cross-review, when: { only_area: tests }, action: agent_review, reviewer: { different_family: true }, reason: "Tests only; a reviewer from another model family checks them." }
default: { action: human_approve, reason: "A person decides." }
policies.two-docs:
version: 1
rules: []
---
rules:
  - { when: { risk: low }, action: auto_merge, reason: r }
policies.assets:
version: 1
classify:
  area:
    web: ["web/**"]
binary:
  allow: ["web/assets/**/*.png"]
rules:
  - { name: web, when: { area: web }, action: agent_review, reason: "An agent checks web changes." }
default: { action: human_approve, reason: "A person decides." }
